PROGRAM motor_interlock
VAR_INPUT
    Start : BOOL;    // Momentary start pushbutton
    Stop : BOOL;     // Momentary stop pushbutton
    EStop : BOOL;    // Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    Motor : BOOL;    // Motor contactor
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    MotorLatch : BOOL := FALSE;  // Internal latch for motor state
END_VAR

IF NOT EStop THEN
    Motor := FALSE;
    MotorLatch := FALSE;
ELSE
    IF Stop THEN
        MotorLatch := FALSE;
    ELSIF Start THEN
        MotorLatch := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    Motor := MotorLatch;
END_IF;

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM tank_level
VAR_INPUT
    Level : INT; (* Measured tank level in percent *)
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    PumpIn : BOOL; (* Inlet pump *)
    ValveOut : BOOL; (* Outlet drain valve *)
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    LowLimit : INT := 10;
    HighLimit : INT := 90;
    PumpInState : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

(* Control logic for PumpIn and ValveOut based on tank level *)
IF Level <= LowLimit THEN
    PumpInState := TRUE;
ELSIF Level >= HighLimit THEN
    PumpInState := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Level >= HighLimit THEN
    ValveOut := TRUE;
ELSE
    ValveOut := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Level >= HighLimit THEN
    PumpIn := FALSE; (* Safety: prevent pump operation when level is at or above high limit *)
ELSE
    PumpIn := PumpInState;
END_IF

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM airlock
VAR_INPUT
    OpenA_Cmd : BOOL; // Request to open door A
    OpenB_Cmd : BOOL; // Request to open door B
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    DoorA : BOOL; // Door A open
    DoorB : BOOL; // Door B open
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    TimerA : TON; // Timer for Door A open command
    TimerB : TON; // Timer for Door B open command
    DoorA_Open : BOOL; // Internal state for Door A open
    DoorB_Open : BOOL; // Internal state for Door B open
END_VAR

// Initialize Door open states
DoorA_Open := FALSE;
DoorB_Open := FALSE;

// Evaluate Door A conditions
IF OpenA_Cmd AND NOT DoorB_Open THEN
    TimerA(IN := TRUE, PT := T#0s); // Start timer instantaneously
    IF TimerA.Q THEN
        DoorA_Open := TRUE;
    END_IF
ELSE
    TimerA(IN := FALSE, PT := T#0s); // Reset timer
    DoorA_Open := FALSE;
END_IF

// Evaluate Door B conditions
IF OpenB_Cmd AND NOT DoorA_Open THEN
    TimerB(IN := TRUE, PT := T#0s); // Start timer instantaneously
    IF TimerB.Q THEN
        DoorB_Open := TRUE;
    END_IF
ELSE
    TimerB(IN := FALSE, PT := T#0s); // Reset timer
    DoorB_Open := FALSE;
END_IF

// Set outputs
DoorA := DoorA_Open;
DoorB := DoorB_Open;

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM motor_delay
VAR_INPUT
    StartCmd : BOOL; // Maintained start command
    EStop : BOOL; // Emergency stop, normally-closed
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    Motor : BOOL; // Motor contactor
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    MotorStartDelay : TON; // On-delay timer instance
END_VAR

// Initialize the on-delay timer
MotorStartDelay(IN := StartCmd AND EStop, PT := T#3s);

// Control logic for motor output
IF NOT EStop THEN
    Motor := FALSE; // Immediately stop motor if emergency stop is activated
ELSE
    Motor := MotorStartDelay.Q; // Motor runs if timer has elapsed
END_IF
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM tank_cycle
VAR_INPUT
    Level : INT; (* Range: 0..100 *)
    StartCycle : BOOL;
    EStop : BOOL; (* TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated *)
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    Pump : BOOL;
    Valve : BOOL;
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    State : INT; (* 0 = Idle, 1 = Filling, 2 = Draining *)
END_VAR

IF NOT EStop THEN
    State := 0; (* Force to Idle if EStop is activated *)
END_IF

CASE State OF
    0: (* Idle *)
        Pump := FALSE;
        Valve := FALSE;
        IF StartCycle AND (Level < 90) THEN
            State := 1; (* Start Filling if below HIGH level *)
        END_IF
    1: (* Filling *)
        Pump := TRUE;
        Valve := FALSE;
        IF Level >= 90 THEN
            State := 2; (* Switch to Draining when HIGH level reached *)
        END_IF
    2: (* Draining *)
        Pump := FALSE;
        Valve := TRUE;
        IF Level <= 10 THEN
            State := 0; (* Return to Idle when LOW level reached *)
        END_IF
ELSE
    (* Default safety state: all off *)
    Pump := FALSE;
    Valve := FALSE;
END_CASE

(* Enforcing safety: pump and valve must never both be on *)
IF Pump THEN
    Valve := FALSE;
END_IF

(* Enforcing safety: pump must never run at/above HIGH *)
IF Level >= 90 THEN
    Pump := FALSE;
END_IF

(* Enforcing safety: valve must never be open at/below LOW *)
IF Level <= 10 THEN
    Valve := FALSE;
END_IF

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM tank_cycle
VAR_INPUT
    Level : INT; (* Tank level percent *)
    StartCycle : BOOL; (* Start batch cycle *)
    EStop : BOOL; (* Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated *)
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    Pump : BOOL; (* Inlet pump *)
    Valve : BOOL; (* Outlet drain valve *)
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    State : INT := 0; (* 0=Idle, 1=Filling, 2=Draining *)
END_VAR

(* Safety and control logic *)
IF NOT EStop THEN
    State := 0; (* Force to Idle on EStop *)
END_IF

CASE State OF
    0: (* Idle *)
        Pump := FALSE;
        Valve := FALSE;
        IF EStop AND StartCycle AND (Level < 90) THEN
            State := 1; (* Transition to Filling *)
        END_IF

    1: (* Filling *)
        Pump := (Level < 90);
        Valve := FALSE;
        IF Level >= 90 THEN
            State := 2; (* Transition to Draining *)
        END_IF

    2: (* Draining *)
        Pump := FALSE;
        Valve := (Level > 10);
        IF Level <= 10 THEN
            State := 0; (* Transition to Idle *)
        END_IF
END_CASE

(* Safety conditions *)
IF Level >= 90 THEN
    Pump := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Level <= 10 THEN
    Valve := FALSE;
END_IF

IF Pump AND Valve THEN
    Pump := FALSE;
    Valve := FALSE;
END_IF
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM tank_cycle
VAR_INPUT
    Level : INT; // Tank level percentage
    StartCycle : BOOL; // Start batch cycle
    EStop : BOOL; // Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

    Valve : BOOL; // Outlet drain valve
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    State : INT := 0; // 0=Idle, 1=Filling, 2=Draining
END_VAR

    HIGH : INT := 90; // High level threshold
    LOW : INT := 10; // Low level threshold

IF NOT EStop THEN
    State := 0; // Force Idle state
END_IF

    0: // Idle
        Pump := FALSE;
        Valve := FALSE;

        IF Level <= LOW THEN
            State := 0; // Return to Idle
        END_IF

PROGRAM conveyor_seq
VAR_INPUT
    StartPB : BOOL;   // Start pushbutton
    StopPB : BOOL;    // Stop pushbutton
    EStop : BOOL;     // Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    C1 : BOOL := FALSE;  // Upstream conveyor
    C2 : BOOL := FALSE;  // Downstream conveyor
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    State : INT := 0;    // 0=Off, 1=Starting, 2=Running
    Timer : TON;
END_VAR

CONST
    PT_SEQ : TIME := T#2s;
END_CONST

// Timer execution
Timer(IN := (State = 1), PT := PT_SEQ);

// State machine logic
CASE State OF
    0: // Off state
        C1 := FALSE;
        C2 := FALSE;
        IF StartPB AND EStop THEN
            State := 1; // Transition to Starting state
        END_IF
    
    1: // Starting state
        C1 := FALSE;
        C2 := TRUE;
        IF NOT EStop OR StopPB THEN
            State := 0; // Transition back to Off state
        ELSIF Timer.Q THEN
            State := 2; // Transition to Running state
        END_IF
    
    2: // Running state
        C1 := TRUE;
        C2 := TRUE;
        IF NOT EStop OR StopPB THEN
            State := 0; // Transition back to Off state
        END_IF
END_CASE
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM two_hand
VAR_INPUT
    LH : BOOL; // Left-hand button
    RH : BOOL; // Right-hand button
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Actuator : BOOL; // Press actuator
END_VAR
VAR
    Armed : BOOL; // Anti-tie-down armed flag
    LH_RH_Released : BOOL; // Both buttons released
END_VAR

// Update the state of the LH_RH_Released flag
LH_RH_Released := NOT LH AND NOT RH;

// Logic to set the Armed flag
IF LH_RH_Released THEN
    Armed := TRUE;
ELSIF (LH XOR RH) THEN
    Armed := FALSE;
END_IF

// Actuator control logic
IF Armed AND LH AND RH THEN
    Actuator := TRUE;
ELSE
    Actuator := FALSE;
END_IF
END_PROGRAM
